column2: Ask [Root.GetTitledName] to lend you a fleet of 20 ships for this war, for 50 gold. The ships are yours to command and disband when the war ends.
[afl_requester.GetTitledName], our ally, asks us to lend a fleet of 20 ships for the war, and offers 50 gold in return.
Our ally has agreed. A fleet of 20 ships awaits our orders in the nearest port.
Our ally has refused to lend us ships.
